messages:
ops-bot: Heads-up: APAC SIN2 (apac-sin2) is opening a limited pilot for Dedicated micro-pools featuring the new Vulcan-A500X (4x 80GB) hardware. Soft-open starts Mon 2026-04-06 09:00 SGT. :rocket:
sana: quick Q: is this a hard launch or pilot?
evan: (product) pilot only. limited capacity for early adopters, labelled "vulcan-pilot". We'll monitor latency and throughput before full GA.
maria: (infra) Technical notes: added memory-aware kernel selection for Vulcan-A500X; local KV-cache alignment improved. Expect 8-14% token throughput uplift on long-context workloads.
yuki: (ops) Billing/policy change during pilot: reservation minimum for these pockets lowered to 7 days (pilot-only, apac-sin2). On-demand shared-burst pricing applies otherwise. Pricing details in the doc.
pricing-bot: Pricing snapshot (internal): Vulcan-A500X reserved unit: $XX/hr (committed), shared-burst on-demand: $YY/hr. Reservations bill pro-rata by day.
evan: scheduler updates: for the first 96 hours we bias scheduling to reserved tenants in apac-sin2 to stabilize SLAs. After that period we open more shared-burst traffic.
ops-bot: Effect on customers: no automatic migration for existing reservations. Customers can request pilot buckets; Sales will prioritize strategic accounts.
sana: how do teams request capacity?
sales-bot: Use the Capacity Request Form linked in the runbook. Sales is offering a 30-day pilot incentive for approved early adopters.
maria: infra config snippet (for infra/ops):
```
pool_name: apac-sin2-vulcan-pilot
node_type: vulcan-a500x
pool_mode: hybrid
priority_window_secs: 345600  # 96h
fairshare: { reserved: 300, shared: 75 }
backfill_policy: prefer_reserved_then_shared
alert_group: capacity.vulcan.spill
```
evan: Important: added a new alert channel capacity.vulcan.spill for when packing causes spillovers to shared pools. Oncall: please subscribe during pilot.
ops-bot: Runbook + internal docs: https://intra.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/vulcan-sin2-pilot (internal) - do not externalize yet.
sana: any quota caps for orgs?
pricing-bot: Pilot quotas: default per-org reserved cap = 4 nodes total. Exceptions require Sales approval.
evan: Ops actions: enable fairshare weights at 09:00 SGT, open monitoring dash for Vulcan metrics, and run the kernel tune push at 02:00 SGT.
maria: Infra actions: will enable packed scheduling and KV-cache alignment patch to staging tonight. Prod push tomorrow morning pre-open.
ops-bot: CS action: notify top APAC reserved customers about pilot and 7-day reservation option. Sales to coordinate messaging.
sana: thanks, please ping #eng-runtime with any regressions and tag @maria/@evan.
ops-bot: Reminder: this is a pilot and may see rapid config changes. If you notice perf or billing anomalies, file an incident and tag capacity-vulcan. :rotating_light:
